xc_files.plain_code:
var $dash_c = screen("dash_c", 0)
var $dash_l = screen("dash_l", 2)
var $dash_r = screen("dash_r", 2)

const $max_airspeed = 500 ; km/h

array $ores : text
array $distances : number

storage var $oreIndex : number
storage var $distanceIndex : number
var $mode = 0

init
	$ores.from("Fe,Al,Cu,C,Ti,W,Au,U", ",")
	$distances.append(0.1, 0.5, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 30, 50, 100)

shutdown
	var $screen = screen(1,0)
	$screen.blank()

function @blank()
	$dash_c.blank()
	$dash_l.blank()
	$dash_r.blank()

function @dashboard()
	var $motorsOn = input_number("dash_l", 1)
	var $anchorOn = input_number("dash_r", 0)
	var $drillOn = input_number("dash_r", 1)
	var $throttle = input_number(0, 7)
	var $prop1 = input_number("prop_fl", 0)/-100
	var $prop2 = input_number("prop_fr", 0)/100
	var $prop3 = input_number("prop_bl", 0)/-100
	var $prop4 = input_number("prop_br", 0)/100

	$dash_c.blank()
	
	; Airspeed / Anchor
	$dash_c.text_align(top)
	if $anchorOn
		if $motorsOn and round(time*2)%2==0
			$dash_c.write(13, 10, red, "ANCHORED")
		else
			$dash_c.write(13, 10, yellow, "ANCHORED")
	else
		var $airspeed = input_number("nav", 0)*3.6
		var $speedRatio = clamp($airspeed / $max_airspeed, 0, 1)
		var $centerX = 64
		var $centerY = 34
		var $speedX = -cos($speedRatio*pi) * $centerY
		var $speedY = -sin($speedRatio*pi) * $centerY
		var $quadrantColor = color($speedRatio*255, max(0,128-$speedRatio*128), 0, $speedRatio*255)
		if $airspeed > $max_airspeed and round(time*3)%2==0
			$quadrantColor = yellow
		$dash_c.draw_circle($centerX, $centerY, $centerY, gray, $quadrantColor)
		$dash_c.draw_rect(0, $centerY+1, $dash_c.width, $dash_c.height, black, black)
		$dash_c.draw_line($centerX, $centerY, $centerX+$speedX, $centerY+$speedY, yellow)
		$dash_c.text_align(top)
		$dash_c.write(15, 12, white, "AIRSPEED")
		$dash_c.write(15, 23, white, text("{0} km/h", $airspeed))
	
	; Throttle
	var $throttleColor = gray
	if $motorsOn
		$throttleColor = color($throttle*255, 255-$throttle*255, 0)
	$dash_c.draw_rect(5, lerp(68, 0, $throttle), 15, 68, black, $throttleColor)
	$dash_c.draw_line(15, 66, 15, lerp(66, 2, $prop1), color($prop1*255, 255-$prop1*255, 0))
	$dash_c.draw_line(17, 66, 17, lerp(66, 2, $prop2), color($prop2*255, 255-$prop2*255, 0))
	$dash_c.draw_line(19, 66, 19, lerp(66, 2, $prop3), color($prop3*255, 255-$prop3*255, 0))
	$dash_c.draw_line(21, 66, 21, lerp(66, 2, $prop4), color($prop4*255, 255-$prop4*255, 0))
	$dash_c.draw_rect(5, 1, 24, 68, color(100,100,100))
	$dash_c.draw_rect(0, lerp(68, 1, 0.6), 30, lerp(68, 1, 0.5), color(0,0,0,64), color(128,128,128,64))
	$dash_c.text_align(top_left)
	$dash_c.write(7, 3, black, "T\nH\nR\nO\nT\nT\nL\nE")
	if $motorsOn
		$dash_c.write(6, 2, white, "T\nH\nR\nO\nT\nT\nL\nE")
	else
		$dash_c.write(6, 2, gray, "T\nH\nR\nO\nT\nT\nL\nE")
	
	; Motors On
	$dash_c.text_align(top)
	if $motorsOn
		$dash_c.write(14, 38, cyan, "MOTORS ON")
	else
		$dash_c.write(14, 38, gray, "MOTORS OFF")
	
	; Battery
	var $batt1 = input_number("batt1", 2)
	var $batt2 = input_number("batt2", 2)
	$dash_c.draw_rect(26, 50, lerp(26, $dash_c.width-2, $batt1), 59, 0, color(255-sqrt($batt1)*255,sqrt($batt1)*128,0))
	$dash_c.draw_rect(26, 58, lerp(26, $dash_c.width-2, $batt2), 68, 0, color(255-sqrt($batt2)*255,sqrt($batt2)*128,0))
	$dash_c.draw_rect(26, 50, $dash_c.width-2, 68, color(100,100,100))
	$dash_c.text_align(top)
	$dash_c.write(12, 55, black, "BATTERY")
	$dash_c.write(11, 54, white, "BATTERY")
	
	; Drill On
	$dash_c.text_align(bottom)
	if $drillOn
		$dash_c.write(14, -7, cyan, "DRILL ON")
	else
		$dash_c.write(14, -7, gray, "DRILL OFF")
	
	; Composition Screen
	if input_number("dash_l", 4)
		var $drillComposition = input_text("drill",0)
		var $out = "\n"
		foreach $ores ($i, $element)
			var $v = $drillComposition.$element
			if $v
				$out &= text("{}: {00.00} % \n", $element, $v:number * 100)
			else
				$out &= $element & ":         \n"
		$dash_l.blank()
		$dash_l.text_align(top_right)
		$dash_l.write($out)
	else
		$dash_l.blank()
	
	; Scanner
	if input_number("dash_r", 3)
		; select distance
		if $dash_r.button_triangle(6, $dash_r.height-30, 2, $dash_r.height-21, 10, $dash_r.height-21, blue, yellow)
			$distanceIndex = ($distanceIndex + 1) % $distances.size
			$dash_r.blank()
			return
		if $dash_r.button_triangle(6, $dash_r.height-10, 2, $dash_r.height-19, 10, $dash_r.height-19, blue, yellow)
			$distanceIndex = ($distanceIndex + $distances.size - 1) % $distances.size
			$dash_r.blank()
			return
		; select ore
		if $dash_r.button_triangle($dash_r.width - 7, $dash_r.height-30, $dash_r.width - 3, $dash_r.height-21, $dash_r.width - 11, $dash_r.height-21, blue, yellow)
			$oreIndex = ($oreIndex + 1) % $ores.size
			$dash_r.blank()
			return
		if $dash_r.button_triangle($dash_r.width - 7, $dash_r.height-10, $dash_r.width - 3, $dash_r.height-19, $dash_r.width - 11, $dash_r.height-19, blue, yellow)
			$oreIndex = ($oreIndex + $ores.size - 1) % $ores.size
			$dash_r.blank()
			return
		var $ore = $ores.$oreIndex
		$dash_r.text_align(bottom_right)
		$dash_r.write($ore &" ")
		$dash_r.text_align(bottom_left)
		$dash_r.write(text("{} km", $distances.$distanceIndex))
		
		var $angle = input_number("pivot",0) * 2pi + pi/2
		var $center_x = $dash_r.width / 2
		var $center_y = $dash_r.height / 2
		var $max = $dash_r.height / 2
		
		if input_number("dash_r", 4)
			if $mode != 1
				$mode = 1
				$dash_r.blank()
			output_number("pivot",0, fract(time/15))
			$dash_r.draw_point($center_x, $center_y, red)
			repeat $max ($i)
				var $d = ($i+1)/$max
				var $dist = $d * $distances.$distanceIndex * 1000;
				output_number("scanner", $i, $dist)
				var $scannerComposition = input_text("scanner",$i)
				if $scannerComposition.$ore
					var $x = round($d * $dash_r.width/2 * cos($angle))
					var $y = round($d * $dash_r.height/2 * sin($angle))
					if $x or $y
		; 				var $v = smoothstep(0.2, 0.9, $scannerComposition.$ore)
		; 				var $v = step(0.0, $scannerComposition.$ore)
		; 				var $v = pow($scannerComposition.$ore, 0.5)
						var $v = $scannerComposition.$ore
						$dash_r.draw_point($center_x + $x, $center_y - $y, color(0,$v*255,0,255))
		else
			if $mode != 0
				$mode = 0
				$dash_r.blank()
			output_number("pivot",0, sin(time)/8)
			$center_y = $dash_r.height - 1
			$dash_r.draw(0,0, color(0,0,0,15), $dash_r.width, $dash_r.height)
			$dash_r.draw_point($center_x, $center_y, red)
			$max = $dash_r.height
			repeat $max ($i)
				var $d = ($i+1)/$max
				var $dist = $d * $distances.$distanceIndex * 1000;
				output_number("scanner", $i, $dist)
				var $scannerComposition = input_text("scanner",$i)
				if $scannerComposition.$ore
					var $x = round($d * $dash_r.width * cos($angle))
					var $y = round($d * $dash_r.height * sin($angle))
					if $x or $y
		; 				var $v = smoothstep(0.2, 0.9, $scannerComposition.$ore)
		; 				var $v = step(0.0, $scannerComposition.$ore)
		; 				var $v = pow($scannerComposition.$ore, 0.5)
						var $v = $scannerComposition.$ore
						$dash_r.draw_point($center_x + $x, $center_y - $y, color(0,$v*255,0,255))
	else
		$dash_r.blank()
